outcome: postpartum depressive symptoms (measured by screening questions and EPDS scores)
cohort: Pregnant patients admitted to labor and delivery units from March through December 2020, including 129 patients with positive COVID-19 tests and 516 matched COVID-19 negative controls.
finding: No significant differences in the rates for postpartum depressive symptoms were observed among pregnant women with and without a positive COVID-19 test during pregnancy.
